<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 180.0423 likely corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.03498 Da. A formula that matches this mass within sub‑mDa accuracy and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1 and ≈1.3 % M+2, indicating ~9 C atoms) is C₉H₇O₄. This formula gives a calculated monoisotopic mass of 179.03448 Da (Δ ≈ 0.5 mDa) and predicts the observed isotope intensities. Therefore the molecular formula is C9H7O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
